original_agent_description: Author specification-based RTL and verify Yosys hygiene and canonical formatting. The AGENT authors synthesizable RTL; the TOOL verifies it in the same run -- authored RTL is never reported as good until it has elaborated and passed hygiene. Screens for inferred latches, undriven and multiply-driven nets, and RESET HYGIENE read structurally from the elaborated netlist (Yosys cell types and parameters): one reset net used both async and sync, one net used at both polarities, a reset also sampled as data, or a reset tied to a constant. Naming-convention and de-assertion-synchronizer findings are reported as advisory because neither is provable from structure alone. Node-agnostic (no PDK binding required).
